welcome.text: 👋 Hi! I'm AI Job Copilot, your personal AI job-search assistant. I'll help you build a professional CV, find matching vacancies and prepare personalised applications to employers. 🎁 Your first 5 applications are free.
welcome.resume_onboarding: Welcome back! Let's continue where you left off.

how.text: How AI Job Copilot works 1. Upload your CV or create one with AI. 2. I improve it and suggest matching professions. 3. You set your search criteria — location, format, salary. 4. I find current vacancies from official sources and check how well they match. 5. I find the official way to apply and write a personalised cover letter. 6. You review everything — nothing is sent without your confirmation. 7. I track your applications and responses. You stay in control of your data at all times.

consent.text: 🔒 Your data and privacy To help you, I need to process your CV and profile data (name, contacts, work history, skills). • Your data is used only to build your CV and find jobs for you. • Nothing is sent to employers without your explicit confirmation. • You can export or delete your data at any time in Settings. Please read the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
consent.summary: Privacy summary • What we store: your CV files, profile data, search settings, generated letters and application history. • Why: to provide CV building, job matching and application features you request. • AI processing: CV text and job descriptions are sent to our AI provider to analyse and generate texts. They are not used to train public models under our provider agreements. • Email: we only send emails you confirm. Gmail access is requested separately and can be disconnected at any time. • Your rights (GDPR): access, correction, export, deletion and withdrawal of consent — all available in Settings. • Retention: data is kept while your account is active and deleted on request.
consent.declined:
Understood. Without consent I can't process your CV, so job-search features are unavailable.

You can change your mind at any time.
consent.required: Please accept the privacy terms first to use this feature.

builder.intro: ✨ Let's create a professional CV. I'll ask a few questions and then prepare the text, structure and design myself. You can answer in your own words or with a voice message, and skip optional questions.
builder.resume_or_restart: You have an unfinished CV. Continue where you left off?
builder.ask_name: What's your name? Write your first and last name exactly as they should appear on the CV.
builder.ask_location: Which city and country do you live in? Example: Vienna, Austria
builder.ask_linkedin: Do you have a LinkedIn profile? Send the link or skip.
builder.ask_portfolio: Do you have a portfolio or personal website? Send the link or skip.
builder.ask_direction: What kind of job would you like to find? If you're not sure yet, I'll help you choose a direction based on your experience.
builder.ask_target_role: Which position are you looking for? Example: Video Editor
builder.ask_experience: Tell me about your latest or current job: position, company, dates and what you did. You can write normally or record a voice message.
builder.ask_experience_more: Tell me about the next job (the one before): position, company, dates and what you did.
builder.nothing_found: I couldn't find the details I need in this answer. Could you rephrase it?
builder.followup_job_title: What was your job title there?
builder.followup_company: What's the name of the company?
builder.followup_dates: When did you work there? Example: 03/2021 – present or 2019 – 2022
builder.followup_responsibilities: What were your main tasks and results there?
builder.adaptive_intro: A few questions about your profession to make the CV stronger:
builder.ask_education: Tell me about your education: institution, degree, specialisation and years. Example: University of Vienna, BA Economics, 2016 – 2019
builder.ask_skills:
Which professional skills and programs do you know?

Tap the ones that apply — and write any others in a message, separated by commas.
builder.ask_skills_none: Which professional skills and programs do you know? Write them separated by commas.
builder.ask_languages: Which languages do you speak and at what level? One per line, for example: English - B2 German - A2 Ukrainian - Native Levels: A1–C2, Native, Fluent. If you don't know the level, just write the language.
builder.ask_extras: Do you have certificates, courses, licences, personal projects or professional links? Write them one per line, or skip.
builder.ask_cv_language: In which language should I create your CV?
builder.ask_cv_language_other: Write the language for your CV, e.g. Polish.
builder.ask_design: I've picked several designs for your profession. ⭐ — my recommendation.
builder.generating: ⏳ Creating your CV: structure, text and design… This can take up to a minute.
builder.generation_failed: I couldn't create the CV right now. Your answers are saved — please try again in a moment.
builder.need_contact: A CV needs at least an email or a phone number. Please send one of them.
builder.need_name: Please send your first and last name.

preview.ready: 🎉 Your CV is ready! I chose a structure that highlights your most relevant experience and skills. You can also write what to change, for example: “Move education lower”, “Emphasise video editing”, “Make it one page”.
preview.edit_hint: Write what to change in your own words, for example: • Add my portfolio https://… • Shorten the description of the restaurant job • Change email to name@example.com • Make the summary more formal I won't add facts that aren't in your profile.
preview.structure_title: Use the arrows to reorder sections, then tap “Done”.
preview.confirmed: ✅ CV confirmed and set as your main CV.
preview.versions_title: 🕘 Versions Tap a version to restore it as the current one.
preview.needs_new_facts: I can only use facts you've told me. To add new experience, education or results, update your profile (/profile) or tell me the details — then I'll regenerate the CV.
preview.nothing_changed: I couldn't understand what to change. Try rephrasing, or use the buttons.
preview.page_limit_failed: ℹ️ Even in the most compact layout the CV takes {pages} pages. Try “Make it shorter” or remove a section.
preview.render_failed: Something went wrong while creating the document. Your previous version is kept.
preview.invalid_value: Some values were invalid and were not applied.

optimizer.title: 📋 I analysed your CV and found some ways to improve it.
optimizer.disclaimer: The score is an estimate based on structure checks. No tool can guarantee passing an employer's system.
optimizer.kept: OK, I'll keep your original CV.

i.no_email: No email address — add one so employers can reply.
i.no_summary: No professional summary at the top.
i.few_bullets: Job descriptions are too short to show what you did.
i.too_long: The CV is longer than recruiters usually read.
i.too_short: The CV is very short — important details may be missing.
i.scanned: The file is a scanned image — many ATS systems cannot read it.
i.long_paragraphs: Long paragraphs are hard to scan — use bullet points.
i.no_experience_section: No experience or education section was found.

examples.intro: 👀 Here are three examples of well-structured CVs (all data is fictional).
examples.classic_ats: Classic ATS Single column, standard headings, no decorative elements — read reliably by applicant tracking systems. Recommended for: logistics, finance, engineering, administration, healthcare.
examples.modern: Modern Professional Clean single column with a coloured header and accent headings. Recommended for: sales, marketing, project management, consulting, IT.
examples.creative: Creative Bold header and a sidebar for contacts and skills. Recommended for: video editing, design, content creation, photography.
examples.outro: Would you like a CV like this?
examples.unavailable: Examples are not available right now.
